passages.text:
Hi Mariam,
Thank you for reaching out! Our Health Partnerships' program on health behavior change for COVID is only for health
nonprofits and UNICEF this year. We have plans to make thetraining more widely available in the coming year or two
through a more open community of practice model. Ahmad and his team continue to support the local USAID mission in
Jordan as his team (Government, Policy, and Nonprofits, or GPN, at Meta) works with government organizations. Are
there specific topics that you all are looking for additional training on?
Best,
Whittney
Whittney Tom
(she/her)
Health Partnerships

Hi Mariam,
Thank you for reaching out! Our Health Partnerships' program on health behavior change for COVID is only for health
nonprofits and UNICEF this year. We have plans to make thetraining more widely available in the coming year or two
through a more open community of practice model. Ahmad and his team continue to support the local USAID mission in
Jordan as his team (Government, Policy, and Nonprofits, or GPN, at Meta) works with government organizations. Are
there specific topics that you all are looking for additional training on?
Best,
Whittney
